schema.title: Software Carbon Intensity (SCI) 1.1.0
schema.description: SCI = (O + M) per R; O = E * I; M = TE * TS * RS = TE * (TiR/EL) * (RR/ToR).

E.description: Energy consumed by the software system for a functional unit of work, in kWh.

TE.description: Total Embodied Emissions: the sum of LCA emissions for all hardware components.

R.description: The functional unit. Suggested: API call/request, Benchmark, User, Machine, Minute/time unit, Device, Physical site, Data volume, Batch/Scheduled Job, Transaction, Database read/write.
